description: Agent 包专项 + Backup Rotation/Credentials 边界深度审阅 — 无新增 signed，全边界覆盖充分

agentPackages.sharedPackagesNoBuildTag: lifecycle, localapi, mcp, oauth, pairing, platformclient, process, queue, sessions, vault

assertions: 原子性: 损坏密文拒绝部分提交 (7/7 完好+损坏)
错误 old key 拒绝轮换 + 密文不变
用户版本不丢失: saved[i].Version 保持原值
用户内容不变: ValueJSON 保持原值
same key 拒绝: err != nil
密文不重复: RotateBackupKey(..., old, next) 后密文已换
密文不含明文 + nonce=12 bytes
成员移除后 restore → 404 (cleanup 清副本)
restore 等 team 锁: pg_stat_activity Lock wait 确认后权限降级才生效

tests: TestEncryptedCredentialsScopeRestartAndDelete — 作用域重启/删除加密凭据
TestVaultUnavailableDoesNotEraseAuthorizedSessionOrRecreateLostKey — vault 不可用不删已授权 session
TestVaultRejectsForeignRootAndSymlink — foreign root + symlink 拒绝
TestCiphertextAuthenticationNonceAndScopedCleanupFailure — ciphertext 认证 + nonce + cleanup failure
TestIndependentDisksSerializeMasterInitialization — 多磁盘 master init 串行

methodology.deepDiveValue: 从 go test exit 0 深入到每个测试函数名 + 断言 — 确认 backup rotation 原子性、credentials 成员移除清理、vault symlink 拒绝等关键安全边界
